performance.verdict: CPL spike is real and worsening; intake leak masks true lead quality.

findings.text: CPL rose 35.89% week-over-week on flat spend (-0.92%), confirmed by 3-day signal: Oct 21–23 averaged 4.7 leads/day vs 6.3 leads/day in Oct 18–20 prior window.
⛔ Extension with Marwan overdue since 2026-08-31; engagement is month-to-month lapsed — contract risk gates all next-phase spend decisions.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; contact rate is stated bottleneck yet CRM tools to reach leads remain unresolved.
GHL shows 149 contacts vs 172 Meta leads (28d) with 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — leads are entering but pipeline is completely empty, an intake leak not an ads failure.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for Oct 21–23 (3 consecutive days vs 8–18/day prior week), diverging from stable GA4 sessions (~68–70/day) — GBP cadence overdue since 2026-09-30.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: map all 172 Meta leads to opportunities; 0 opps from 149 contacts is a confirmed pipeline leak.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 149 contacts and 172 Meta leads over 28 days but zero opportunities created and zero appointments — no lead has advanced in the pipeline. Audit the GHL workflow to ensure every incoming Meta lead form submission auto-creates an opportunity and triggers an intake task for Andrew. Success is confirmed when new leads show up as open opportunities within 24 hours of form submission. Complete audit and fix by 2026-10-28.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new video creative into 'Leads - August Re-Launch'; CPL up 35.89% on unchanged spend signals fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: The sole active campaign 'Leads - August Re-Launch' has delivered 172 leads at a rising CPL (35.89% spike week-over-week, now well above the $19–45/wk range recorded in peak July performance). With spend flat at ~$73.56/day, the lead decline from 6.3/day to 4.7/day over the last 3 days points to creative fatigue. Activate one new 9:16 video creative (Rocco or Marwan on-camera, CROA theme) into the existing campaign per SOW pipeline. Success check: CPL returns below $20 within 7 days of new creative launch. Target live date: 2026-10-31.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 3 consecutive zero-action days Oct 21–23; re-check Oct 27 before treating as demand drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero for three consecutive days (Oct 21–23) after averaging 8–18 actions/day the prior week. GA4 sessions remained stable at 68–70/day over the same period, suggesting this is a GBP-specific posting/cadence gap rather than a demand collapse. The GBP cadence milestone was due 2026-09-30 and remains undelivered. Re-check GBP actions on 2026-10-27; if still at or near zero, escalate as a deliverable blocker to Nacer.
